H.802, An Act requiring photo ID's to vote, is a petition filed by Berthiaume to require valid photo identification be shown to election officials before voting. Referred to the committee on Election Laws. Bill text: 'By Representative Berthiaume of Spencer, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 802) of Donald R. Berthiaume, Jr., for legislation to require the showing of valid photo form of identification to election officials prior to voting.'
